title: Vows of the Crusade
wikitext:
[[File:Vows of the Crusade.png|thumb|Vows of the Crusade]]

'''Vows of the Crusade''' is a book that can be found outside the [[Scarlet Citadel]] in [[Tirisfal Glades]].

{{Book|content=
The Vow of the Initiate

I will give my service unto the Crusade, and pledge my life to its cause, I shall obey without question, I shall answer the call for my people.

The Vow of the Crusader

It is my creed to defend the lands of my people, for Lordaeron is the Crusade, and the Crusade is Lordaeron. I shall dispense justice to all those that wrong my brothers and sisters in arms. I am the embodiment of what once was.
----
The Vow of the Knight

That which is noble, I shall uphold. That what is tainted, I will destroy. That which is sacred, I will protect. To my brothers, and my sisters this oath be true.

The Vow of the Missionary

To the ways of old is the charge of my kind, to preserve the ways and traditions of the holy church, and to sanctify and bless our armaments in this holy war. To purge the deceivers, the heretics and the unfaithful is my cause.
}}
